description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_AlphaValue, which extends the number attribute definition for CSS alpha (opacity) values within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes validation logic to ensure the alpha value remains within the range 0 to 1.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_AlphaValue
classes.description: A class that validates and manages the parsing of CSS alpha (opacity) values, extending the general number attribute definition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the default behavior, indicating that opacity values are non-negative.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input alpha value, ensuring it is within the range 0 to 1 by clamping values outside this range.
